subtitle: Incident status, recovery history, and authorized operator context from the append-only audit log.
bannerBody: Incident and audit data remain read-only. Authorized interventions are durable requests; Core rechecks state, target, and role before applying them.

intervention.unavailable: Intervention requires a canonical Incident id, lifecycle state, and exact server-owned target.
intervention.title: Intervene in this incident

help.operator_guidance: Record human context for the accountable agents without changing lifecycle state.
help.close_as_development: Request a legal, audited lifecycle closure. Delivered actions are not cancelled.
help.create_development_exception: Suppress future Incident creation only for this exact target and duration. Findings and audit continue.
help.revoke_development_exception: Restore Incident intake for this exact target. Previously closed Incidents remain closed.

validation.comment: Enter operator context or a justification.
validation.commentLength: The comment must be 500 characters or fewer.
validation.exceptionId: Enter the exact exception UUID to revoke.

intervention.reviewBody: Review the current Incident binding before submitting. A changed state or target will be rejected.
intervention.authorityNotice: This request grants no execution authority. Core validates role, state, exact target, idempotency, and lifecycle legality.
intervention.queuedBody: The Operator service accepted this request for Core processing. Acceptance does not claim that the Incident changed.
intervention.appliedBody: Core recorded the intervention. The refreshed Incident timeline now shows the authoritative audit evidence.

modeMeaning.enforce: Enforcement mode - changes may be applied

emptyScope: Incidents list only confirmed operational incidents. Inventory refreshes and compliance findings are recorded as audit evidence and approval requests, not as incidents.

reason.noRuleForResourceAndSignal: No response rule matches this resource and signal

source.title: Source incident and response plan
source.openExternal: Open source incident in a new tab

milestones.title: Investigation milestones
milestones.moreEvidence: Additional evidence references are available in Audit.
milestones.moreGaps: Additional evidence gaps are available in Audit.

analytics.label: Verified outcome evidence
analytics.title: Incident outcome cohorts
analytics.ttmUnavailable: Unavailable - no independently verified outcome in this sample
analytics.truncatedExcluded: Bounded at 500 incidents; {excluded} matched incidents not measured
analytics.noDrilldown: No matching incidents in this bounded cohort.

select: Select an incident to inspect its recovery history.
selectNamed: Select {title} and show its recovery history

description.opened: Opened a {severity} incident and began correlating related signals.
description.correlatedOne: Attached one related signal to this incident.
description.correlatedMany: Attached {count} related signals to this incident.
description.notificationEscalation: Notification delivery could not complete and requires operator attention.
description.notificationEscalationReason: Notification delivery could not complete and requires operator attention. Recorded reason: {reason}
description.approvalRequested: Requested human approval before the proposed action can continue.
description.approvalUnavailable: The approval request could not be delivered to the configured approval channel.
description.requestHeld: Held the operator request because the available evidence was insufficient for a governed action.
description.auditRecorded: Recorded the latest decision and action evidence in the append-only audit log.

overview.label: Current situation

body.resolved: The incident lifecycle is resolved. Review the activity history for the recorded outcome and recovery evidence.
body.notification_failed: FDAI is still collecting related signals, but no configured operational-alert channel accepted the notification. No remediation decision or action has been recorded.
body.approval_delivery_unavailable: The proposed response is parked for human approval, but FDAI could not deliver the approval request through an approval channel. Operational alerts may still be available, and no change will be applied without approval.
body.approval_required: A proposed response is waiting for an authorized person. FDAI will not apply the change until the required approval is recorded.
body.response_failed: A response attempt failed. Review the latest activity and failure evidence before choosing another action.
body.response_in_progress: A governed response has started and has not reached a terminal outcome yet.
body.monitoring: The incident is open while FDAI correlates related signals. No remediation decision or action has been recorded yet.

overview.concurrentApprovalDelivery: The approval request also could not be delivered through an approval channel. Human approval is still required.

next.resolved: Confirm the recorded recovery evidence and close any remaining operational follow-up.
next.notification_failed: Restore or configure an operational alert channel, then review the technical activity. Root-cause analysis has not started.
next.approval_delivery_unavailable: Open Approvals to review the parked request, then check Settings > Integrations and ask the deployment owner to configure approval delivery if it is unavailable.
next.approval_required: Open Approvals and review the proposed response, evidence, impact scope, and rollback contract.
next.response_failed: Inspect the failure record and rollback evidence before retrying or choosing a different response.
next.response_in_progress: Monitor the latest activity until verification completes or the response is held for review.
next.monitoring: Review the technical activity and related signals. Wait for an evidence-backed decision before applying changes.

evidence.title: Available evidence
evidence.body: Only views backed by recorded evidence are enabled. Unavailable analysis is not inferred from generic activity.
evidence.auditBody: Browse all {count} recorded events and their raw evidence fields.
evidence.traceBody: Inspect {count} ordered events, including correlation and notification routing.
evidence.rcaBody: Review recorded, evidence-backed cause hypotheses and citations.
evidence.rcaUnavailable: Not available yet because no root-cause hypothesis has been recorded.
evidence.reportBody: Open the full incident and root-cause evidence package.
evidence.reportUnavailable: Not available until root-cause evidence has been recorded.

emptyHistory: No audit entries for this incident.
viewPurpose: Incident-centric roster and recovery history projected from the append-only audit log. Read-only.
